name: Emergency Health Sabbatical Recommendation
description: Recommendation to the Board on an emergency restoration-of-health sabbatical after the request and physician certification are received.
deadline: As soon as feasible after receipt of request and medical certification
quote: Requests for an emergency restoration of health sabbatical will be recommended to the Board as soon as feasible, after receipt of the request and a medical certification from the employee’s physician (as described above).
